write_up: Your resume tells a common story: you moved from warehouse work to dispatch support and then to Dispatcher at Crossroads Regional Freight. The direction is clear, but the current job mostly lists duties without showing how many drivers or loads you handle, or what your part looks like. That makes it tough to stand out for another dispatch job.

The load-tracking line is your best model because it names both the work and who gets the updates. Your progression at Crossroads is easy to follow, and your current role is dated through the present.
